text: いちど　かちぬいた　きみは　もう　ちょうせんは　できないけど…　しょうぶ　だけは　できるぞ！

structure.jp: いちど　かちぬいた　きみは
structure.en: you, who already won through once,

structure.jp: もう　ちょうせんは　できないけど…
structure.en: can't take the challenge anymore, but...

structure.jp: しょうぶ　だけは　できるぞ！
structure.en: a battle at least, you can have!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いちど　かちぬいた　きみ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a person or thing describes it, like 'who...' in English. いちど　かちぬいた　きみ = 'you, who won through once'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts with 'but'. できないけど = 'you can't, but'.

patterns.name: 〜だけは
patterns.explanation: だけ means 'only' and は sets it apart from the rest, giving 'at least this one thing'. しょうぶ　だけは = 'a battle, at least'.
